project.name: Sample docs workspace
project.summary: A workspace that starts empty until you import a document.

briefing.title: Start here
briefing.body: The workspace is empty until a document is imported. Import accepts Markdown, HTML, and DOCX, and the file stays in the current workspace.

placements.title: Empty workspace
placements.where: The empty workspace, beside the prompt to import a document
placements.context: This workspace has no document yet. Import is the way to give it one.

tasks.title: Import your first document
tasks.summary: Bring a document into the current workspace so the app has something to show.
tasks.details: Import accepts Markdown, HTML, and DOCX. Markdown headings become the outline, HTML tags become blocks, and Word comments are dropped. The file stays in the current workspace.
steps: Leave the document in the current workspace.
